claim_text: Sara Beck asked whether there was CIA involvement among the anti-government protesters (reported contemporaneously as: 'I heard about CIA involvement among these anarchists?').
discovery_sources: ICE 2023-03-02 contemporaneous report; The Seventh Eye 2023-03-07 report with screenshot and stronger paraphrase
resolution_notes: The closest contemporaneous transcription recovered is interrogative rather than a clean categorical assertion. The Seventh Eye paraphrases the exchange more strongly as the CIA operating/standing behind the protests. Exact original Channel 14 video has not been recovered, and no robust non-social counter-evidence directly resolving the alleged CIA role was found. Preserve as Pending; do not force False/Unsupported from absence of evidence or from the stronger secondary paraphrase.
media_status: Exact broadcast screenshot is preserved by The Seventh Eye; original Channel 14 clip/direct asset recovery pending.
